title: Armory Bundle Format (ABF) credential requirements
description: Declares which identities a bundle needs, resolved locally by the importer against its own account store at import/launch time. Secret VALUES are never present in this file, or anywhere in an ABF bundle -- only the shape of what's required. BETA: this schema may change in a future v0.x release before 1.0. See https://docs.agentmux.ai/abf for the full specification.

id.description: Stable identifier for this requirement within the bundle, referenced by import-review UIs.

provider.description: e.g. 'github', 'anthropic', 'aws' -- matches the importer's own account-provider taxonomy.

scopes.description: Advisory only -- shown to the user at import, not enforced by the schema.

env.description: Environment variable name the resolved credential is injected as at launch, e.g. 'GITHUB_TOKEN'.

optional.description: If true, the bundle functions (in a reduced capacity) without this credential resolved.
